If at decision "Customer interested?" no => probably end? Not specified. Could end process or loop? Probably end "process ends when order placed". So if not interested, end maybe "End not interested". Add end event.

The no path of "Customer interested?" leads to end "Not interested". The no path of "Quote approved?" leads to end "Quote not approved". Or could loop but not defined.

tok 1.0 "Product inquiry and order process"

pool organization "Organization"
  lane customer "Potential Customer"
    start start_inquiry "Process start"
    task inquire "Inquire about product or service"
  lane sales "Sales Staff"
    task collect "Collect information and address concerns"
    xor interested "Customer interested?"
    task guide "Guide through selecting appropriate product or service"
    task quote "Provide a quote"
    xor approved "Quote approved by customer?"
    task place_order "Place order"
    and record_confirm "Record order and send confirmation"
    task record "Record order in system"
    task confirm "Send confirmation to customer"
    and recorded "Joining parallel"
    end placed "Order placed and confirmed"
    end not_interested "Process ended - not interested"
    end not_approved "Process ended - quote not approved"
